subject: Constant conditional expression
notes: Rule: non-numeric, non-boolean relation — no collating sequence, binary per-character equality, unequal length => not equal (cite.py --check 7.3.8.3 '...If the literals are of unequal length they are not equal.' OK). Code: CceRelation delegates to CtValue.RelationalEquals (binary, length-sensitive for alphanumeric/national); boolean right-zero-extends per §8.8.4.2 (GR2 excludes boolean). Probes (pinned cobol.exe, 2023): c1 '"abc" = "ABC"' FALSE; c2 '"AB" = "AB "' FALSE (no space padding); d5 'X"41" = "A"' TRUE (binary encoding); d11 '"ab" IS <> "AB"' TRUE; c19 N"AB" = N"AB" TRUE; c23 NOT = TRUE. Cce_TrueFalse pins equal / unequal-length / case-sensitivity with spec-derived values.
